steps.text: Mom, is Dad going far away again? For how long this time?
The snow and ice upon the river are about to melt. The rain this year has been just right, and it doesn't seem like there will be a drought or a flood.
The newly reclaimed land upstream isn't a whole lot, but it should be enough to grow rice for the family to eat.

Mom, can you try talking Dad out of it? So he can set aside his 'business'? I don't want new clothes or beautiful jewelry. I just want us to have an ordinary family life. That's what's most important.
I'm... kind of scared...

a.text: From a poor village to a prosperous town, from green saplings to a field of weeds.
Straw shoes traverse a thousand li, from tall mounts and vast lakes comes one's home.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*....

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: There's a cliff... up ahead...

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Dammit! I'm really not gonna get away this time...

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Don't panic, you can't afford to lose your cool... Even if you can't win in a fight, there should be enough traps along the way to make her eat it.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: When I manage to catch her, I'm gonna need to teach her a hard lesson... for daring to look down on me...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Tired of running yet?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: How did you–

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You look young, but you've got a hefty bag of tricks. Did the one who taught you to hunt ever tell you that traps meant for beasts won't hold a man?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Besides, aren't you worried that you'd land yourself an extra charge if someone were to fall into one of your traps? Intentional damages?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: What a joke... intentional damage? That's nothing! I've got a rap sheet... too long to list!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So what you're telling me is, if I strike you down here, then your death would be deserved?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: I mean... no, definitely not!

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: You stay away from me!

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: See this bag of explosives here? Come one step closer and I'll pull the trigger. No matter how good you are at kung fu, I'll take you down with me!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Alright, I'll stay put then. You answer my question.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Don't think you're gonna get anything out of me!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: How did you come to know that band of robbers over in that cave?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Hah, come to know them? I'm their leader.

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: You might've made short work of my boys, but don't get cocky. I swear, I'm gonna avenge them!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Leader? At your age?

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: Oh? Got a problem with that? Go ask every village within ten li and see who hasn't heard of the fearsome 'Fang Xiaoshi.'

steps.name: Panicked Youth
steps.text: You'd be scared to death if you knew the terrible things I've done!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Ridiculous...
Twelve hours earlier...

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Xiaoshi! Boss!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What's going on? Our enemies looking for trouble?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Am I finally gonna get to fight someone? Can you bring me along this time?

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Damn it all, the guys who went to Yumen somehow pissed off a she-devil! She's been rampaging through our men on her way here!

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: It's too late to pack your stuff, just start running!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What are you talking about? Just one woman?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You guys looked pretty tough when we were showing our moves before, so how come you can't even beat a lone woman?

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Cut the crap. Where's the burdenbeast you were in charge of?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Um... I sold it.

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: You sold<i/> it?!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Weren't you the one who told me to take it to get something to eat?

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: You dumbass! I told you to ride the burdenbeast into town to trade the gems we looted, and you sold off the burdenbeast too?!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: That bags of rocks? The butcher didn't even know what those things were.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: He saw our burdenbeast was pretty sturdy, so he gave me a good price. Half in cash, the other half in jerky.

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: You little––!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: How long have we been stuck in these mountains? What's the point raising a stupid burdenbeast anyway? It ate more than us, and who knows when it might've attracted another tuskbeast over.

steps.name: Panicked Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Ma de! Why'd I ever pick up a little shit like you? You're gonna be the death of me! Why I oughta–

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: What's a kid doing here?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Who... who the hell are you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No wounds. Guess you weren't involved in what happened in Yumen.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I know Shanhaizhong's depravity well, but I never expected them to get a little kid involved... Looks like there really is no limit to how low these people will stoop.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I have no idea what you're talking about!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Hey, lemme cut you a sweet deal. I'll let you off the hook for taking out my boys, for the time being.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Step aside, and I'll pretend I never saw you. Then, we'll each go our own way–

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I didn't give you permission to leave.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I told you, stay back!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Last warning! I've got explosives...
The boy feels only a gust of wind blowing past him. The cloth bag in his arms is ripped apart, beast jerky and various knickknacks fall to the ground.
Among the knickknacks is a protective talisman carved from a wooden plaque strung on a thick iron key. Painted upon it in conspicuous vermilion brush-strokes are the characters, 'Moushan Village.'

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: A talisman... from Moushan?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Give it back!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Is this the key to your home?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What's it to you?!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: A kid with a family to go back to should not be running around like this.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You're still young, so it's not your fault you don't understand the people you've gotten mixed up with... But, you at least should be able to tell good from evil.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Even if you weren't a part of their plot, if their accomplices ever came knocking on your door, do you know what would happen to you?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Who are you to lecture me on good and evil?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I could also take you to the authorities, and you could explain yourself there.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Though, that would be a little troublesome for me as well...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'll take you home and let your family sort things out.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'm not going back! Over my dead body!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: That's not for you to decide.
The boy pulls a short knife from his waist. He extends his arms out straight, and the tip of the knife shakes uncontrollably.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Don't make me do this!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: A real man's not scared of death. How can he just bow his head and surrender?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'm not going with you, no matter what. Kill me, if you have what it takes–

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Very well–
Though the woman is clearly two meters away from him, the moment her voice rings next to his ear, the same side of his body goes numb.
Before he can react, a cold blade is already pressed against his throat.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So, you're afraid of death after all.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Good. That means you're not a complete idiot.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: There will always come a time when a man must answer for his words and actions. Anyone can say stupid things, but not everyone has fortune on his side.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What... do you want from me...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Show me the way. I'm taking you home.
This is the last town before the mountains, and there is only one inn to be found.
The place is not particularly spacious, and the two occupy a table in the corner.
The moment the boy's rump lands on the chair, his gaze starts darting around left to right, causing the patrons at the next table to look over.
Qiubai gently places her sword on the table.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No one can save you.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I know, I know. Stop pulling that thing out to threaten people for no reason.
They have been traveling for two weeks. One chases, the other flees. One is angered, the other cowers. Yet through this, they've formed a tacit understanding of sorts.

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Head due north from this town, pass through a deserted forest, and you'll see a river at the northernmost end. On the other side is a mountainous area, and there's only one way in. Just follow the road and it'll take you there.

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: There should be a few villages in the mountains, but I've heard some have relocated over the years. Can't say for sure if the 'Moushan Village' you're looking for is still there.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: How much longer do you think it'll take?

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: The mountain roads are hard to traverse. Even if you try to rush it, it'll probably still take a week.

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Oh right, spring is coming. The weather's starting to warm up, and beasts will be on the move. Be careful, if you're in a hurry.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Appreciate it.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You told me you left home to 'become an adventurer,' but it turns out you haven't made it far from home... At first, I thought you were deliberately leading me the wrong way.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Well, the Jianghu is big, and I barely just set out on my journey before I ran into you...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Besides, I'm not stupid. If I led you to some uninhabited wilderness, wouldn't we both starve to death?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Even if I was trying to get away, I'd come up with a better idea.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You sure know how to handle yourself.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Let's eat first. Who knows when next we'll be able to have a good meal after we leave town.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Order whatever you'd like.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Anything? You're paying?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I don't have much on me, so if I end up not having enough to cover it, I'll leave you behind to do dishes.

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: You jest, my friend. A small eatery like this only has enough offerings to sate your hunger.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Ugh, you'd better not expect me to hold back. Hand me the menu!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I want this one, this one, this one... Actually, give me one of everything!

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Excuse me, young sir, are you sure the two of you can...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: (Writes on the table with tea)

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: ('I've been kidnapped–')

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: (*gasps*) ––!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: ('Get help–')

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Are you done yet?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Almost. Let's go with this for now!

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: Okay... Alright...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: To the washroom. What, are you gonna follow me?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Don't try any funny business.

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: That kid just signaled to me that he's been kidnapped...

steps.name: Innkeeper
steps.text: I didn't notice anything out of the ordinary when those two walked in. I thought they were just siblings... I have no idea what's going on...

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Are they inside right now?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: That woman... wouldn't follow me here, right...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Hmph! Keep dreaming, if you think you can catch me.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What awful luck...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: So much for the Shanhaizhong. I thought I was joining a pretty awesome gang, but they ended up getting taken out by one woman... And now, I'm running for my life here.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Didn't make any money, didn't learn kung fu, and even the bag of jerky I got out of it is gone now.
Fang Xiaoshi sits down on the cold, hard ground.
He curses twice, but that sound is overpowered by his stomach growling.
A young man wandering the Jianghu, the world of kung fu, his growling belly empty; the sky is high and the clouds distant, nothing around him but vast emptiness.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I should've had a couple mouthfuls of food before running off... Where am I supposed to go now...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I told you, you only get three strikes.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: How did you–

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: My patience has limits.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Why won't you just leave me alone?!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If I leave you alone in the wilderness, you'll die.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: So what if I die? What do you care?!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: My whole life, nobody's ever given a damn if I live or die.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Why should others care about a life that you don't yourself want?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What the hell do you know...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You've never experienced a life of wandering ever since you were a kid, living by yourself with nobody to rely on.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Stop being all pretentious! How could a powerful swordswoman like you possibly understand–

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: (*gasps*) ––!
The boy turns around, only to realize that he is not the only hungry creature in the woods. From the trees' dusky, mottled shadows, a tuskbeast slowly emerges.
The tuskbeast's blood-red eyes flicker like candles in the dark night, its low-pitched growls making the grass and trees quiver and cower.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: H-Help...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Don't move!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'm not...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Don't make a sound. Don't run. And don't turn your back on it.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Don't panic. Make your way towards me slowly. Get behind me...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I... can't...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Careful now–
Perhaps due to the loose fallen leaves beneath his feet, perhaps due to his nerves, the boy staggers and falls to the ground.
The tuskbeast catches the scent of his fear, keenly seizing the opportunity to hunt. It rushes out at almost the same time as the swordswoman.
On the battlefield, the claws of the tuskbeast should have been no threat at all to the sword.
Had there not been a child in need of protection behind it.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Here, eat up.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I ruined your jerky, so here's some roast to make up for it.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: In what way?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Are you talking about the scratch I got from the tuskbeast, or about how mad you've made me?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: This... is for you.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: It's medicine my dad taught me how to make. He always takes it with him when he goes hunting, and it's good for treating scratches and bites from wild beasts.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: How do I know there's no poison in it?
The boy draws out his knife and makes a deep cut, then pours some powder out from the medicine bottle to apply to the wound.
Though he grits his teeth in pain, he firmly resolves to not utter a sound.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Now do you trust me?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You sure took your sweet time, but you're still my hero.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Hmph. So this is what tuskbeast meat tastes like... Ugh, it's tough and gamey.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Consider yourself lucky to get to eat cooked meat in the wilderness at all.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You do have a point... When I was with those men up in the mountains, it'd be months between a single bite of meat.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Are you talking about your 'boys?' Even the villains known far and wide couldn't get enough food to eat?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Why are you making fun of me...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I've seen my fair share of kids your age running away from home after arguing with their family, but I've never met a kid so desperate to be the bad guy.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: ...I don't want people looking down on me.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What does it matter if you're good or bad? If nobody's scared of you, then you're gonna get bullied.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Who taught you that nonsense?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I figured it out myself... from experience!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You're only half-correct.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: When you become feared, it's true that nobody will bully you anymore. Instead, they'll join hands to get rid of you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The only way avoid making enemies is to avoid treating others as enemies.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I... can I ask you a question?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Your kung fu is so powerful... Where did you learn it?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If you get thrown out there to fend for yourself across the Jianghu for five years, then get tossed into war for another five, you'll be at a similar level. If you survive.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Also, I had an exceptionally strong teacher.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Even stronger than you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Much stronger.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Then, if I train hard from now on, how long would it take for me to reach your level?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Ten years.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Ten years?!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Assuming you survived, that is.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: M-Ma'am...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: What did you just call me?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What would you say to taking me as your disciple?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'll follow you. Whether you're a wanderer or a hero, you'll be my master from now on!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'm not taking disciples. And I'm not about to just casually hand my kung fu to somebody else.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Besides, with how crafty you are, if you use the techniques I taught you to do evil, wouldn't that be my fault?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I promise! If you teach me kung fu, and I become as strong as you and nobody bullies me, I'll obey every word you say and be a good person just like you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You think I'm a good person?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I... I think so...?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: After all, you saved me and gave me food to eat...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You're so strong, but you still spend money to buy things instead of stealing. You're nothing like the others.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So, you're not totally incapable of telling good from evil.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: But, I still don't understand why you're trying to save me.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Is it because heroes like you always butt into people's business?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You've already asked me several questions.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Ma'am... You don't have to take me as your disciple, but at least let me follow you. Anywhere's fine, just don't force me to go home.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I want to ask you something as well.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I can see you still keep the keys to your home with you, so why do you refuse to go back?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: ...I'm not ready yet.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: When I ran away from home, I made up my mind that I wouldn't go back until I've done something worthwhile.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Are your folks still there?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I haven't seen my mom as long as I can remember, but my dad should still be there... I don't have any other relatives.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: All the more reason for you to go home. You have the heart to make your father worry about you?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I don't think me going back would make him happy... Everyone in the village hates me, looks down on me, and bullies me... You wouldn't understand at all.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Same thing I told you before. If you want to get along with people, don't treat them as your enemies.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Besides, how much hatred could anyone possibly have for a boy your age?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I said it, didn't I? I've done a ton of bad things. You'd be scared to death if I listed 'em off for you.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: In other words, I'd rather die than keep living as a nobody.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You wouldn't say that, if only you knew how many people there are across this land who'd do anything for a chance to live.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Forget it. I can't beat you in a fight or in an argument. Whatever you say goes, I guess.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: But one more question: why won't you let me follow you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: A life of wandering has its risks. For a boy like you, it's better to have a place to call home than to be adrift outside.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What about you then? Where's your home?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: ...My home is long gone.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What does that even mean? Was it a Catastrophe, or was it demolished to make way for a nomadic city?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Long gone means long gone. The place is gone, and the people are gone.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: We've been talking about me all day, but why don't you tell me about yourself? I mean, you haven't even told me your name!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Qiubai. 'Qiu' as in hatred, 'bai' as in white snow.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I am a nobody, with no stories to tell.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Well, whatever. If you don't feel like talking, so be it. I know heroes like you love to act all mysterious.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Some stories remain untold because they're unpleasant.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If you've eaten your fill, go rest up. There's a long road ahead of us, so conserve your energy.

a.text: 'Pass the woods, cross the river, and you'll enter the mountains.'

steps.text: Though it is less like a mountain, and more like a forest made up of mountains.
One mount connects to the next, the peak of one mountain connected to the foot of another. There is no end in sight, no road to traverse.
It's as if the happenings of the outside world have no bearing upon what occurs deep in the mountains. It is too remote, and even time itself can be walled off by distance.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: We're almost there! It should be around here somewhere!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You made one hell of a detour just to climb this mountain. What are you trying to do?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I heard that if you stand on the peak here, you can see all the way to Yumen!

The boy tries his best to stand on tiptoes, gazing westward from the cliff. The wild grass grows rampant, and he can see only a faint line of dark yellow at the farthest edge of the horizon. A look of disappointment creeps onto his face.
Qiubai knows that out of sight, the wounded nomadic city is still crawling along the barrens, nervously licking its wounds.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I passed by here a few years ago. Used to be more desolate.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You've been here?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's been a while.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: For the Chidao, right? Look over there!
On the other side of the cliff, a gray trail winds along the terrain and extends all the way to edge of the horizon, quite eye-catching in contrast to the barrens.
'Chidao,' a Yanese infrastructure project for Catastrophe avoidance, resource transportation, and aiding people living in remote areas.
Tens of thousands of such roads interconnect more than a hundred nomadic cities across the country's endless wilderness.

It stretches across wild, untamed mountains and erects bridges over low-lying areas. The supply stations set up along the roads are like neatly-sectioned bamboo nodes, bringing life to every place they reach.
If it can be said that the gods abandoned this barren land, then humans are the ones who once again laid out its veins.
All under heaven is strife, but humanity does what it can.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: After I left home, I would sometimes see Chidao construction teams. But, what's the point of repairing these roads?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: It's not like they can pack up and leave the same way nomadic cities can, so won't they just get torn up when a Catastrophe hits?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The places that nomadic cities don't reach depend on these roads.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Repairing them after they're destroyed is a matter of necessity. The material cost is irrelevant.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But very few know... Very few remember, that there are always people doing this work.
Not long ago, a Catastrophe swept across this mountain headed for Yumen. It caused great damage to the city, but also left behind a heroic tale.
Out here, far from civilization, there were no casualties, no buildings destroyed, and little trace of what took place.
At this moment, only the construction team is still hard at work here, busy repairing this unassuming stretch of road.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I heard that following this road west will lead you to Yumen. You said you'd been all over the place before, so have you been to Yumen?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I have.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: When I was still hanging around those bandits, I heard they were getting some guys together for a big job in Yumen. But, they didn't think I could hold my own in a fight, so they wouldn't bring me along.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Consider yourself lucky.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What kind of place is it? Are there lots of heroes with great kung fu? A bunch of mighty warriors and weapons?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No... It's mostly just ordinary people, going about their ordinary days.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Yumen travels along the desert, and is always followed by the wind and sand. How could the people there possibly have an easy life?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I'm not afraid of hard work, as long as I get to do something meaningful... Sure beats being stuck in this stinky ol' ravine.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Either way, you're not gonna talk me out of it... I'm only heading back home because you told me to, but give me a bit to prepare, and I'll be back out on the road in no time!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I swear, the next time I stand here, the name of Fang Xiaoshi will be known far and wide—no, I'll become a hero known to all!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You'd better worry about becoming a good person first. If I hear anything about your fearsome notoriety again, I'll pay you a visit you won't enjoy.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You always know how to rain on my parade...

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Anyway, we'll reach Moushan after crossing this mountain.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: I know the way back from here.
The light of dawn clears away the mountain mist, and the wind carries a few wisps of chimney-smoke in oblique trails.
Unmelted snow can still be seen atop the peaks in the distance, plots of farmland spread out thinly along the foot of the mountains.
The heavy rain must've hit halfway through the plowing season, the soft soil that had been pushed into ridges washed into a muddy mess once more.
In the places that have not yet been plowed, clumps of soil are packed together tighter and tighter, the heads of wheat from the last crop still droop.
At the end of the Chunfen equinox, working the fields proves to be difficult.
The villagers in the fields put down the plows in their hands, straightening their backs while rubbing their waists.

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: Took long enough for the sun to come out. Looks like today will be a fine day, with just the right amount of sunlight.

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: Gotta till the fields again while I still can...

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: Is it really you?!

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: Fang Xiaoshi...? You're Fang Xiaoshi, aren't you?!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Oh, is that Uncle Dayuan? You bet, look who's back!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Why are you staring at me like that? Are you still mad about that one time I accidentally poured fertilizer into your burdenbeast feed trough?

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: You... You're still alive?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Of course I am.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: But, I haven't seen you in three years, and your back's gotten even more crooked.

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: Jian gui le... damn it all!

steps.name: Plowing Villager
steps.text: I've gotta go tell the Elder!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: See, what'd I tell you? Everyone here hates me.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Looks more to me like they're afraid of you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: How many bad things did you do to make everyone so scared?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: You should ask who started it.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: People are the same wherever you go. They always find the boy who's easiest to pick on... But now that I'm back, I'm not afraid of them anymore!

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: What, never seen such a run-down place before?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: All I'll say is you haven't seen anything yet.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Grr.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But I can add, this is the first time I've seen a temple like that at the entrance to a village.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And over here, why's there a fresh grave?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Because people die. Is that so strange?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: The only thing is, I dunno which family they're from or why they were buried next to the temple.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Well, whatever. I might not know who you are... But if you're buried here, you were probably one of the villagers.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Death is a release anyway. At least your suffering's over.
The boy turns sideways and bows in the direction of the grave. Though his words are frank, his posture is serious.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: We're almost there. My place is just up ahead.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Why'd you stop?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: ...Forget it. Can't hide from it anyway. I'm not afraid.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad, I'm back.
He steps into a tiny shack of wood and mud, to find nobody inside. Various trinkets and knickknacks can be seen all around, but they are organized neatly.
Seeing the leftover food on the stove, the boy seems to let out a sigh of relief.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: That's strange. All the stuff's still here, but nobody's home?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Maybe he's out in the fields? I'll go look for him.

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Dad...? Dad?

steps.name: Fang Xiaoshi
steps.text: Where are you...?

steps.name: Agitated Villager
steps.text: Stop him! Don't let him get away!
